```yaml
name: mbridge-deps-sync

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:

jobs:
  sync-deps:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Upgrade GitHub Actions versions
        run: |
          # Update actions/checkout to v6
          sed -i 's|actions/checkout@.*|actions/checkout@v6|' .github/workflows/*.yml
          
          # Update actions/upload-artifact to v6
          sed -i 's|actions/upload-artifact@.*|actions/upload-artifact@v6|' .github/workflows/*.yml
          
          # Update actions/download-artifact to v7
          sed -i 's|actions/download-artifact@.*|actions/download-artifact@v7|' .github/workflows/*.yml
          
          # Update actions/github-script to v8
          sed -i 's|actions/github-script@.*|actions/github-script@v8|' .github/workflows/*.yml
          
          # Update actions/setup-python to v6
          sed -i 's|actions/setup-python@.*|actions/setup-python@v6|' .github/workflows/*.yml

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add .
          git commit -m "ci: upgrade GitHub Actions for Node.js 24 compatibility" || echo "No changes to commit"
          
      - name: Push changes
        uses: actions/github-script@v8
        with:
          script: |
            const { execSync } = require('child_process');
            try {
              execSync('git push origin HEAD:main', { stdio: 'inherit' });
            } catch (error) {
              // If there are no changes, git push will fail, which is expected
              console.log('No changes to push');
            }
```
